import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        
        long sum = 0;
        long remaining = n;
        
        while (remaining-- > 0) {
            long x = scanner.nextLong();
            sum += x;
        }
        
        System.out.println(sum / n);
        
        scanner.close();
    }
}
